proposal.summary: Layout bug: on the checkout page in Firefox 128, the 'Apply coupon' button overlaps the order total when window width is under 600px.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Document as a UI/UX bug and forward to the frontend/layout team for a fix; include repro steps and browser/version (Firefox 128) and a screenshot if available.

evidence_quotes.claim: Describes the bug and affected browser/version
evidence_quotes.quote: on the checkout page in Firefox 128, the 'Apply coupon' button overlaps the order total when the window is narrower than 600px.
Steps: open cart, resize window, look at the right column.
Expected: button wraps below the total.

evidence_quotes.claim: Assessment that this is not a security issue
evidence_quotes.quote: Not a security issue, just layout.
